derivation: or מַתְכֻנֶת; from H8505 (תָּכַן) in the transferred sense of measuring;

words.word: any other like it after the composition
to yourselves according to the composition

occurrences.text: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our God.
Upon man’s flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.
words: any other like it after the composition

occurrences.text: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the Lord.
words: to yourselves according to the composition

occurrences.text: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of God in his state, and strengthened it.
The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer, and the ephah the tenth part of an homer: the measure thereof shall be after the homer.
